items.briefing:
Australian organisations are being reminded of the importance of business continuity planning, with new guidance on how to maintain critical operations when IT systems go down. Separately, managed service providers are flagging gaps in Microsoft 365 security readiness as AI tools become more widely adopted — a concern relevant to RTOs increasingly relying on cloud-based platforms for training delivery and administration.

Scamwatch continues to report active scam activity targeting Australians, so staff should remain cautious about unexpected emails, calls, or messages requesting personal or financial information.

**Practical tip:** Make sure you know who to contact and what steps to follow if your organisation's systems suddenly become unavailable — check that your business continuity contacts and procedures are up to date.

featured.title: Minimum viable company: Recover faster when systems go dark
featured.summary: Focusing on the right systems first can cut recovery time and help firms avoid reintroducing risk after a cyber attack.
